title: readParallelPolyData
body:
## readParallelPolyData

Reads a partitioned VTK XML polydata dataset: the .pvtp summary file plus the per-piece .vtp files it lists, typically written by an MPI run. The pieces are combined into polydata (surfaces, lines, vertices) with their point and cell arrays. Use it to reopen distributed surface output, including Schemaxis's own native parallel geometry; in Schemaxis MPI runs it is one of the operations qualified for distributed reading. Use readSurface for a single .vtp file.

Common mistakes and assumptions:

- The .pvtp summary refers to its piece files by relative path; move them together.
- Pieces may share boundary points; run clean before connectivity or point-count checks.

Native constructor: `XMLPartitionedPolydataReader`. Identity: `sources/XMLPPolyDataReader`. Role: `pipeline`. Output kinds: `["data"]`.

### Inputs

No connected inputs (source/resource).


### Options

| Key | Meaning / native assignment | Type and constraints | Default / required | Example value |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `files` | The list of files to be read by the reader. Each file is expected to be in the partitioned VTK XML polygonal dataset format. The standard extension is .pvtp. If more than one file is specified, the reader will switch to file series mode in which it will pretend that it can support time and provide one file per time step. Fixed at construction; cannot vary per visit. | `{"type":"array","items":{"type":"string","minLength":1},"minItems":1,"maxItems":1}` | `required` | `["REPLACE_WITH_VALUE"]` |

Execution contract:

```json
{
  "mode": "serial",
  "performance": "unknown"
}
```

### Syntax example

Place in `nodes`. Data outputs may be selected by a scene; resource outputs must be connected to a compatible consumer.

```json
{
  "id": "result",
  "filter": "readParallelPolyData",
  "options": {
    "files": [
      "REPLACE_WITH_VALUE"
    ]
  }
}
```
